corrections.reason: Transposition and lookalike misread of clearly printed Amharic ከራሳቸው ('from themselves', matching L09 ከራሳቸው አንቅተው).
Canonical Ge'ez citation (Jeremiah 22:30: ጸሐፍዎ ለብእሲ ከመ ዘሞተ 'Write this man down as one who has died'); 6th-order ፍ followed by ዎ was misread as ፈዮ.
4th-order ባ in Amharic ባለው ('where it says መጽሐፈ ልደቱ, it says One in black ink') misread as 1st-order በ.
Faintly inked ኒ in archaic Andemta form የለኒህ ('that which belongs to these [David and Abraham] is more numerous', matching L09 ለኒህ) was dropped as a space.
The wrapped verb ያ↵መጣል ('he will bring/cite later') had ጣ misread as ጻ.
